definitions.explanation: Indicates that a road, path, or area is open and can be passed through. Used on signs, in traffic information, and in general descriptions of road conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通行可|つうこうか}です。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、{通行可|つうこうか}になった。
examples.english: The construction has finished and the road is open to traffic again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{積雪|せきせつ}→積雪：14737_sekisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{除雪|じょせつ}→除雪：18195_josetsu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通行可|つうこうか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The road was temporarily closed due to snow accumulation, but became passable after snow removal.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧ (traffic; passage) and {可|か} (possible; permitted). Often seen on road signs and in traffic advisories. The {可|か} suffix is concise and formal, common on signs and official notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通行可|つうこうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: passable road
- ⟦{片側|かたがわ}→片側：20150_katagawa⟧{通行可|つうこうか}: one side passable (one-way alternating traffic)
- ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧{通行可|つうこうか}: open to vehicles
- ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧{通行可|つうこうか}: open to pedestrians

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧: road closed; no passage — the opposite, indicating the road is blocked
- ⟦{通行禁止|つうこうきんし}→通行禁止：24673_tsuukoukinshi⟧: no passage; traffic prohibited — a more formal/permanent prohibition
- ⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: traffic restrictions — partial limitations on passage
- ⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: passable — a slightly less abbreviated form meaning the same thing
